name: Vargouille AP OLD
source: Pathfinder #157: Devil at the Dreaming Palace

offensiveAbilities.name: Kiss
offensiveAbilities.description: The vargouille kisses an adjacent creature that's asleep, Paralyzed, or Unconscious, exposing it to the vargouille transformation disease.

offensiveAbilities.name: Shriek
offensiveAbilities.description:
The vargouille shrieks, its scream so terrible that all non-vargouilles within 60 feet must succeed at a DC 16 Fortitude Saving Throw save or be Paralyzed for 3 rounds.

The effect ends early for a creature if the vargouille moves out of sight, moves farther than 60 feet from the creature, or attacks the creature with its fangs.

After attempting its save, a creature is immune to that particular vargouille's Shriek for 24 hours.

offensiveAbilities.name: Vargouille Transformation
offensiveAbilities.description:
Exposing the victim to sunlight or any light spell of 3rd level or higher pauses the progression of the disease until the victim is no longer in light.

Saving Throw DC 18 Fortitude Saving Throw

Stage 1 carrier with no effect (1d6 #hours hours)

Stage 2 victim's hair falls out (1d6 #hours hours)

Stage 3 victim's ears grow into leathery wings, tentacles sprout on the chin and scalp, and the teeth become long, pointed fangs (1 day)

Stage 4 victim's mind regresses to a vicious and unintelligent shell of its former self (1d6 #hours hours)

Stage 5 victim's head breaks free of the body (which dies) and becomes a new vargouille

offensiveAbilities.name: Vargouille Venom
offensiveAbilities.description:
Saving Throw DC 18 Fortitude Saving Throw

Stage 1 Damage the victim has taken from vargouille fangs can't be healed magically.

Once all vargouille fang damage has been healed nonmagically, the poison ends.

recallKnowledge: Arcana or Nature or Religion, DC 16
